title: Duel Decks Anthology: Divine vs. Demonic: card flavor text

entities.name: Grelden
entities.description: A warrior who received a priest's blessing and later awoke covered in his enemies' blood on the field of victory.

entities.name: Akroma
entities.description: An angelic avenger at whose feet even those born to battle lay their blades; she vows to fight until Phage is destroyed.

entities.name: Phage the Untouchable
entities.description: A deadly figure whom Akroma vows to destroy; she warns that a victim's next words will be their last.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: A man who speaks of his family sheltering in an angel's light while the dark waited.

entities.name: Numai
entities.description: A place where a journal describing a survivor alone among fallen friends was found.

entities.name: Calexis
aliases: Calexis, deacon of the New Order of Serra
entities.description: A deacon of the New Order of Serra who speaks of an angel's burning stare.

entities.name: New Order of Serra
entities.description: A religious order devoted to Serra, of which Calexis is a deacon.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: The figure whose angels bear hopes aloft and empower noble causes.

entities.name: Rafiq of the Many
entities.description: A warrior who says that even in single combat he is never alone.

entities.name: Gerrard
entities.description: A man of the Weatherlight who jokes about the two ways to get past a gate.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The vessel with which Gerrard is associated.

entities.name: Simic
entities.description: A group that uses Daggerclaw Imp claws as scalpels.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: A group that uses Daggerclaw Imp claws for tattooing and torture.

entities.name: Gruul
entities.description: A group that uses Daggerclaw Imp claws to pick their teeth after eating the carcass.

entities.name: Hob Heddil
entities.description: A speaker who advises using bangstuff to remove imps from chimneys.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: The liege from whom Lim-Dûl asks for power.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: A necromancer who petitions his liege Leshrac for power.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who threatens to take a person's most precious secret; she learned the secrets she sought at a price etched on her fate.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: The keeper of the Vault, who views pawns as expendable so long as the king reigns; Mayvar is his minion.

entities.name: Vault
entities.description: The place kept by Geth.

entities.name: Mayvar
entities.description: A minion of Geth who claims the blood, marrow and spirit of his victims.

entities.name: Order of the Ebon Hand
entities.description: An order that bred thrulls and was ultimately overwhelmed by them.

entities.name: thrulls
entities.description: Creatures bred at a terrifying pace that overwhelmed the Order of the Ebon Hand.

events.summary: Grelden kneels to receive a priest's blessing and hours later finds himself covered in his enemies' blood on the field of victory.
events.quote: Hours later, when his wits returned, he was covered in his enemies' blood on the field of victory.

events.summary: Liliana learns the secrets she sought, paying a price etched on her fate.
events.quote: Liliana learned the secrets she sought, but at a price that was etched on her fate.

events.summary: The thrulls bred by the Order of the Ebon Hand multiply and overwhelm the order.
events.quote: In the end, they overwhelmed the Order of the Ebon Hand.

relations.note: Akroma vows to fight until Phage is destroyed.
relations.quote: Until the world unites in vengeful fury and Phage is destroyed, I will not stay my hand.
—Calexis, deacon of the New Order of Serra
"Leshrac, my liege, grant me the power I am due."

relations.note: The thrulls overwhelmed the order that bred them.
relations.quote: In the end, they overwhelmed the Order of the Ebon Hand.

rejected.summary: A journal writer, after a shimmering journey, finds himself alone among the corpses of his fallen friends; the journal was found in Numai.
rejected.quote: When my vision cleared, I found myself alone among the corpses of my fallen friends.
